authoritative_data: RenderProjector owns a disposable read-only projection index. RecordRegistry owns persistent types; transport and VtkView own version/hash admission and scene installation respectively.

input_output: RenderContribution has record_type/topology/project callback; RenderCellSource has EntityId, RenderCellKind and variable-arity node IDs.

RenderProjector::update returns Result<RenderUpdate> with optional full RenderPacket, RenderDelta, work stats and legacy_line2_compatible; input is DocumentView/ViewSession/directed changes/force_full.
implemented_subset.errors_and_effects: Trusted contributions freeze before projection. Projector reads committed records, never writes document authority. Wrong view/version, unsupported topology or quota returns Result diagnostics; transport validates resource/frame hashes and VtkView admits scene updates separately.
